source_checks.explicit_disable: exp0_real.launch sets controller/use_mppi_execution_limits true or false outside the MPPI-only group; false short-circuits capacity_at before derivative evaluation and returns scale=1 regardless of stale MPPI params
source_checks.startup_parameters: same /whole_body_mppi/base_limits vmax,wmax,wheel_v,track are read once; enabled invalid/missing limits fail startup rather than using mismatched defaults
source_checks.tangent_convention: unscaled speed > controller/yaw_hold_speed; native adapter consumes same parameter; default .04. Undefined near-stop yaw has omega=0
source_checks.signed_wheel_equivalence: max(abs(v-track*w/2),abs(v+track*w/2)) equals abs(v)+track*abs(w)/2, including reverse gear
source_checks.old_phase_guard: target_scale begins at execution_scale and retains minima from tracking/safety/arm; after existing rise/fall smoothing, scale is clipped again to old-phase cap before exactly one phase integration
source_checks.new_phase_guard: after phase advances once, current published scale is clipped to capacity_at(new phase), without integrating again
source_checks.force_freeze: existing force_freeze sets scale exactly zero before both nonnegative upper bounds; perception/odom/joint freshness and base hold behavior remain intact. Existing arm-error target-zero smoothing remains unchanged
source_checks.feedforward_parameter: max_feedforward_omega unchanged; it clips legacy car_cmd only and does not substitute for MPPI angular limit
source_checks.logging_correction: pure capacity slowdown no longer logs Base tracking lag; unchanged lag message emits only if position/yaw tracking itself requests slowdown
source_checks.headers: explicit algorithm/cmath/stdexcept dependencies added; no dependence on incidental header inclusion
source_checks.launch_parse: actual ROS launch config parsed for use_mppi=true and false, assign_machines=False, no ROS node/master/hardware started; parameter and executable choice correct
source_checks.deployment: private class layout changed, root must deploy freshly rebuilt libcontroller_utils.so and mm_controller_node together; this review did not deploy

test_scope.cpp_execution: owned by root build/test phase, not claimed by this source review
test_scope.integration_review: actual source reconstruction confirms no unintended changes to original clock logic

limits_of_claim: Bounds the nominal velocity demand at the published phase; not a full acceleration feasibility proof.
Adapter time extrapolation and its future horizon can still see slightly changing curvature; real actuator saturation, stopping checks, and coupled validation remain required.
Source/offline approval is not hardware acceptance.
authorized_review_edits: one existing log condition now tests position/yaw scales rather than total capacity-constrained scale
